caption:
Algebra says two. The graph says one.

Squaring √(x + 7) = x + 1 creates a fake root. Graph both sides in Desmos and only the real solution shows up.

Save this for test day.
tiktok_caption: Squared both sides and got two answers? Desmos shows which one is real.

youtube.title: Extraneous Solutions: Desmos Shows the Real One
youtube.description: Graph both sides of a radical equation to see that only one algebraic root is real. SAT-style practice question (original).
